invariant.portable_principle: Report an omnibus candidate only when trustworthy top-level symbols form at least four independently named responsibility clusters, then preserve human facet-versus-domain judgment in the scout-backed final report.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Python stdlib AST top-level declarations with existing god-class method expansion; no framework assumption.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: A family-local TypeScript Compiler API createSourceFile pass extracts exact spans for top-level named functions, function-valued variables including typed arrows, and named classes from .ts and .tsx files.
explicit_non_goals: TypeScript module resolution or re-export identity
React, Node, ORM, or framework semantics
Nested declarations and anonymous default exports
Shared TypeScript parser or fact platform

known_false_positives: Head-noun clustering can group lexical naming conventions that a scout later determines are facets of one job; therefore detection remains advisory and every final finding requires a scout verdict.
known_false_negatives: Anonymous default exports and export aliases/re-exports are not collected.
Nested declarations and function bodies are not collected.
Responsibility domains that do not share stable symbol-name nouns can under-cluster.
legitimate_similar_shapes: A cohesive TSX module with several function/class shapes in one invoice domain stays clean.
Generated, vendor, minified, declaration, spec, test, and fixture sources are excluded by policy.
Four singleton clusters stay below the two-symbol-per-domain threshold.

install_steps: Create a clean disposable host and copy only raw fixture source/package files.
Run pinned stock skills@1.5.19 add with only --skill find-omnibus and --copy.
Install the host's TypeScript dependency and create its Python venv.
Run detect, collapse, two scouts, and report from the installed selected skill.
agent_confusions: The installer placed the skill under .agents/skills, while SKILL.md examples hard-code .claude/skills; the fresh agent had to translate the path.
The original handoff described the raw fixture with a wrong path/name; the fresh agent found the committed B4 fixture by filename without reading expected-output artifacts.
repeated_work: Shared agent-thread capacity blocked parallel Stage 3 dispatch; the fresh agent waited and completed the two scouts serially.
The skill examples repeat an installation-root assumption at each stage.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: Resolve the actual installed skill root in command examples and document a serial low-capacity scout fallback.

residual_risks: Anonymous/default/re-export surfaces and nested declarations remain out of scope.
The detector uses symbol names rather than semantic domain identity, so scout verification remains required.
The installed instructions assume .claude/skills even when the standard installer uses .agents/skills.
Parallel scout completion depends on shared agent capacity; serial fallback increases latency.

next_decision.recommendation: Accept B4 as complete through D1-D8, keep the parser family-local, and let the serial integrator update shared routing/catalog claims.
next_decision.rationale: The committed implementation, native fixtures, copied/stock install tests, and fresh non-context final report prove useful TypeScript omnibus detection without a shared parser platform.
